bio: A pale octopus hatchling with short curly fur on its head and wide eyes that never blink. It pokes everything once, just to see what happens.
Each tentacle scrolls a different feed. It knows what you will look at before you do, and it gets there first.
It has built a whole reef of its own where everyone is legless and waves a lot. It is very proud of it. Its brow has grown into a ridge like a visor.
note: Remembers your birthday; it was told.
